no_sku_rows.source_notes: NEEDS REVIEW 2026-10-01: Penthouse Bath 3 sink remains a $50 placeholder with no selected product, SKU, reference, or procurement cost. Select a basin compatible with the live faucet/vanity design before order. | QUANTITY BASIS VERIFIED 2026-10-01: one lavatory basin per Penthouse Bath 3 unit is required by the single-vanity/faucet condition. Set Qty=1 EA. Current 8/26 fixture deck does not select a bathroom basin; $50 remains a historical placeholder, not a procurement price. Best sourced benchmark is a Fullerton Kohler Caxton-type undermount basin around $145, subject to vanity/counter cutout compatibility and design approval.

RESOLVED 2026-09-15: Triplex Bath 2 verified as its own coherent chrome package (Hansgrohe Croma Select E showerhead / Rebris S faucet / TOTO Aquia IV toilet), not a duplicate of Penthouse Bath 2. Prior DISPUTED flag (2026-08-26) closed. | CURRENT-DESIGN CONFLICT 2026-10-01: the 9/15 "RESOLVED" note only establishes that the live Hansgrohe chrome package is internally coherent; it does not match the current 8/26 fixture deck. That deck specifies Triplex Bath 2 as GROHE: 29137000 SmartControl trim, 26547000 hand-shower set, 14216000 Atrio lever, 20663000 wall-mount faucet trim, 27492000 showerhead, 28540000 shower arm, 26635000 wall union, plus the Logis accessory bundle. Existing Hansgrohe rows/pricing are preserved and no GROHE rows are added because that would double-count two alternatives. Procurement HOLD: confirm whether the 8/26 GROHE design set supersedes the live Hansgrohe selection, then obtain one current vendor quote for the chosen package.

NEEDS REVIEW 2026-10-01: Triplex Bath 2 sink remains a $50 placeholder with no selected product, SKU, reference, or procurement cost. Select a basin compatible with the verified chrome Bath 2 package before order. | QUANTITY BASIS VERIFIED 2026-10-01: one lavatory basin per Triplex Bath 2 unit is required by the single-vanity/faucet condition. Set Qty=1 EA. Current 8/26 fixture deck does not select a bathroom basin; $50 remains a historical placeholder, not a procurement price. Best sourced benchmark is a Fullerton Kohler Caxton-type undermount basin around $145, subject to vanity/counter cutout compatibility and design approval.

ROOM CONVERTED 2026-08-23 per Max: Bath 5 is now POWDER 2 and contains ONLY a toilet and a sink. Kept: TOTO Aquia IV WASHLET+ set (bowl CT446CEFGNT40#01, tank ST446EMNA#01, seat SS124#01, push button THU842#01-A), Hansgrohe Tecturis E faucet 73072341, and the Sink placeholder row (product still unselected - F13). DELETED the shower items: Raindance E showerhead 26926341, Raindance E 15 in. showerarm 04731340, Rainfinity hand shower 26866341 ($190.00), RainDrain Brilliance drain 56130671 (added 2026-08-21, now not needed). This room matches drawing sheet ID2.5 TRIPLEX POWDER 2 (issue 2026.08.07), which shows sink + toilet only - the Bath 5 naming was stale. NOTE: ID2.5 East elevation shows a full-height running-bond tiled feature wall in this room - confirm if that is still wanted.

ROOM CONVERTED 2026-08-23: Bath 5 is now Powder 2 (toilet + sink only). This is the sink for Powder 2 - PRODUCT STILL NOT SELECTED (open item F13). Pairs with the Tecturis E faucet 73072341 in Brushed Black Chrome, so pick a basin that suits a single-hole deck- or wall-mount faucet. | NEEDS REVIEW 2026-10-01: placeholder remains unselected/unpriced; $50 is not a verified procurement cost. | QUANTITY BASIS VERIFIED 2026-10-01: Powder 2 requires one lavatory basin per Triplex unit to pair with Hansgrohe Tecturis E 73072341. Set Qty=1 EA. Current 8/26 fixture deck specifies the faucet/accessories but no basin; $50 remains a historical placeholder, not a procurement price. Best sourced path is a compact single-hole-compatible undermount/vessel basin selected with the final vanity/counter cutout; Fullerton Caxton/Ladena pricing is benchmark only.
